Container.Name: EveBox-Proxy-IDS
Container.Overview: EveBox web interface for Suricata events and alerts. Reads the shared Suricata logs read-only; persistent SQLite database with default seven-day retention. HTTPS and login enabled; initial admin password is shown in container Logs. This is an event viewer, not a Suricata rule editor. Choose a free host TCP port if 5636 is occupied.

Config.Name: HTTPS WebUI port
Config.Description: On a custom VLAN use the container IP and port 5636. On bridge networking use the mapped host port.

Config.Name: EveBox data
Config.Description: Persistent SQLite events, users and certificates.

Config.Name: Suricata event logs
Config.Description: Must match the sensor event-log host path.

Config.Name: Persistent login and TLS configuration
Config.Description: Keeps generated credentials and certificates across container recreation.
